import string

def meets_basic_password_policy(s):
    if len(s) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c in string.ascii_uppercase for c in s)
    has_lower = any(c in string.ascii_lowercase for c in s)
    has_digit = any(c in string.digits for c in s)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

import string

def meets_strict_password_policy(s):
    if len(s) < 10:
        return False
    if any(c.isspace() for c in s):
        return False
    has_upper = any(c in string.ascii_uppercase for c in s)
    has_lower = any(c in string.ascii_lowercase for c in s)
    has_digit = any(c in string.digits for c in s)
    special_set = set('!@#$%^&*')
    has_special = any(c in special_set for c in s)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit and has_special

import string

def meets_all_char_class_policy(s):
    if not (8 <= len(s) <= 64):
        return False
    has_upper = any(c in string.ascii_uppercase for c in s)
    has_lower = any(c in string.ascii_lowercase for c in s)
    has_digit = any(c in string.digits for c in s)
    has_special = any(not c.isalnum() for c in s)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit and has_special
